verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a way to version, review, or roll back automations such as scheduled jobs, changefeeds, or agent workflows in CockroachDB. Backup and point-in-time restore roll back data, not automation definitions, so that is an adjacent capability and earns no credit. Versioned automation management is a fair thing to ask of a database platform, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
